subject.title: [Feature]: Discord: Re-process edited user messages (MESSAGE_UPDATE event)

question: Should Discord edited-message reprocessing land as default-on behavior in the active PR, require opt-in config/debounce, or be split from delete-to-cancel before merge?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but default/config behavior and whether to bundle delete-to-cancel with this edit-only request are product and upgrade-semantics choices that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Settle Semantics In Linked PR
options.body: Use the active PR or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

options.title: Require Opt-In Edit Config
options.body: Implement `handleEdits` and edit debounce as disabled-by-default Discord config, matching this issue's compatibility proposal at the cost of new config surface.

options.title: Split Delete-To-Cancel
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and leave delete-to-cancel on the broader lifecycle tracker if cancellation semantics are not ready.

recommendation.title: Settle Semantics In Linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the active PR or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current history across the Discord listener, startup, provider, and review paths involved in the semantics choice.
